meaning: 74 reviewer observations, including overlaps and simplification proposals. Addressed means a selected documented plan response, not 74 production defects fixed or business risks eliminated.

findings.issue: Sales scripts and one pipeline
findings.selected_action: Restored short unsent drafts and fit fields in the one current client flow; retired the old multi-stage pipeline.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Demand experiment and prospect roster
findings.selected_action: Retained the bounded twenty-account/two-cohort learning example by reference to the complete V2 archive, including controls and substitution detail; no live-lead or contact quota.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Incident and change records
findings.selected_action: Restored change/incident cards as sections of the same receipt.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Business setup and readiness
findings.selected_action: Restored the compact identity, terms, payment/bookkeeping, tax/coverage and cash setup record; old budgets remain historical.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Per-client repository, environment, MFA and secrets
findings.selected_action: Restored per-client boundaries, lockfile, MFA, least privilege, vault and owner-controlled recovery.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Conditional anti-bot server verification
findings.selected_action: Restored conditional server-side token verification and end-to-end form tests without mandating a provider.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Remotion license and source-versus-finished-media handoff
findings.selected_action: Restored input rights and the distinction between finished media and an operable licensed editable project.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Preliminary business-name status
findings.selected_action: Explicitly labeled name research preliminary; identity and rights remain implementation prerequisites.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Raw legacy keyword files and provenance
findings.selected_action: Restored the V2 raw/CSV pair and both V3 raw keyword evidence files; archives preserve originals.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: One compact operating register
findings.selected_action: Selected three connected records plus existing access/invoice systems, with no duplicate ledger.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Neutral feedback, testimonial and introduction drafts
findings.selected_action: Restored neutral feedback and consent for exact claims/name/logo; no sentiment-gated review requests.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Historical review/change authority
findings.selected_action: Archived the complete older decision record; it cannot override V5.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 maps concerns to multiple authority files but does not state a conflict-precedence rule; build-contract primary_authorities also does not name its own release-gate role.
findings.selected_action: Named one current authority per domain and a rule for reconciling a conflict before making the affected commitment.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 retains separate repository/accounts and a high-level least-privilege gate, but drops the concrete per-client environment, MFA, reproducible-build, ownership, and dependency/renewal controls.
findings.selected_action: Restored isolation, dependency, account/renewal and reproducible recovery requirements.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 says to keep credentials out of prompts and use synthetic leads, but no longer states scoped secret storage or the no-source/browser/log prohibition.
findings.selected_action: Restored scoped secret storage and explicit source/browser/prompt/log exclusions.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 assigns retention/deletion to the client and mentions closure, but lacks a concise required retention/deletion record and export method.
findings.selected_action: Added minimal-data purpose, owner, retention/deletion trigger, export and access-removal evidence.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 requires a working provider record and inbox receipt but omits the conditional server-side verification rule and several delivery safeguards.
findings.selected_action: Added server validation, spam/rate/duplicate behavior, durable record and actual inbox receipt; conditional token verification.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 retains a generic rights/source check but omits the Blender input-rights inventory and Remotion editable-source versus finished-media licensing condition.
findings.selected_action: Restored actual asset and source/runtime license checks before promising source handoff.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 identity acceptance says name review/rights records are real but drops the explicit preliminary-name and no-clearance status.
findings.selected_action: Kept selected identity distinct from legal clearance or paid buyer proof.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 contains protected-staging, rollback, and release-matrix concepts but loses the compact hard-blocker list and the noindex/access-control distinction.
findings.selected_action: Restored hard launch blockers and access-controlled confidential staging in addition to noindex.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 has incident and feedback stages, but no compact reusable incident/change record with owner, status, next-update, acceptance, and approval fields.
findings.selected_action: Added compact change and incident fields to the existing receipt.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 reduces acquisition to one or two lanes and growth tests, omitting V3's small pipeline stages, 20-account research example, founder-send control, and learning targets.
findings.selected_action: Restored acquisition learning and unsent drafts within the six-stage flow; no autonomous outreach authority.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 requires a static/CMS choice before deposit but does not preserve V3's proof sequence for self-editing fit.
findings.selected_action: Require an agreed editing route before deposit; do not imply that repository ownership provides a CMS.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 claims preservation of 359 legacy phrases and provenance but omits V3's raw legacy keyword evidence files from the package.
findings.selected_action: Restored both V3 raw keyword artifacts and complete history snapshots.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Renewal and cancel timing plus blocked prepaid Search cycle are incomplete
findings.selected_action: Added exact renewal timestamp/timezone and cancel route, invoice pause, unused-cycle refund/credit choice and partial-work reconciliation.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Written milestone acceptance can stall; cancellation reconciliation lacks a work ledger
findings.selected_action: Added one approver, written acceptance, delay notice/rebooking and dated work/cost/payment ledger for termination.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Care acknowledgment can be mistaken for included repair or restoration
findings.selected_action: Distinguished alert verification/notification/routing from separately scoped repair and restoration; actual coverage required.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Combined Care/Search receipt risks double-counting one change
findings.selected_action: One edit cannot satisfy two paid outcomes; shared deployment QA can run once. Pause Search when no distinct task exists.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Internal 7/10-hour estimates may quietly cut fixed Sprint/Search deliverables when blocked
findings.selected_action: Internal hours guide preflight and estimation; they do not permit an audit-only Sprint or abandoned fixed deliverables.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Ten route illustrations and generic month-two wording hide the actual buying calendar
findings.selected_action: Show a short menu and on-demand calculator. Actual invoice dates override the 11/23-cycle illustration.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Page add-ons may bypass package fit; static editing fit may surface after deposit
findings.selected_action: Add-ons stay within accepted service/market/design direction; CMS/new template/new service/first hero require fresh scope.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Care first-quarter contribution is fragile to small labor overruns
findings.selected_action: Exposed the $29.90 first-quarter Care contribution and -$82.60 overrun case; keep scaling conditional on full paid-quarter evidence.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The 85-hour representative Signature slice and illustrative week-7 date operate as a mandatory booking gate, although V4 also allows equivalent proof or faster measured completion.
findings.selected_action: Replaced the mandatory 85-hour/week-seven gate with relevant capability evidence and actual dated capacity.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Booking from aggregate hours or an AI throughput claim can hide weekly founder review, QA, launches and correction tails.
findings.selected_action: Schedule reviews, QA, launch and correction tails before accepting deposits; parallel work allowed only when those fit.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Known corrections, Search's internal reserve, Care quarterly allowance and pooled recovery can be counted twice if calendar terms are not explicit.
findings.selected_action: Defined which reserves already sit inside each sold unit; pooled recovery covers additional unexpected work.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The 12 build stages plus recurring stages and multiple status artifacts add process cost before paid evidence proves their value.
findings.selected_action: Reduced execution to six stages, three records and one reusable production prompt.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: 35/40/50-hour scenarios and 20/24-hour client caps risk reading as actual availability or a rigid project-count cap.
findings.selected_action: Kept scenario ceilings as sensitivities; actual availability and calendar determine bookings, not a fixed project count.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: A V4-named buyer-needs file still embeds the superseded V3 menu: Care $349, SEO Setup $600, Focused SEO $1,100 and Growth SEO $1,800, plus the old 30-minute Care allowance.
findings.selected_action: Moved the stale buyer-needs menu out of current reference; preserved it only inside its original historical archive.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The preserved search-evidence artifact reports a historical page-map sum of 358 against 359 V2 CSV rows and retains stale historical paths/fragments.
findings.selected_action: Labeled the historical 358 route-map count versus 359 source terms; preserved bytes, with the current 482-term register and site map authoritative.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The register exposes seven assigned route families and many keyword-level publication_stage values while the actual current page shape is a small canonical core plus conditional routes.
findings.selected_action: Keyword destinations are intent assignments; only approved live routes publish, and deferred intent uses its listed fallback.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The twelve-brief backlog, three launch guides, two later defaults and four-to-six-asset stretch language can be read as a multi-tier publishing program despite the explicit no-quota rule.
findings.selected_action: Three evidence-ready launch candidates plus two later defaults; the remaining briefs stay backlog, never a publication quota.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The selected Wonder and Method identity is supported by preliminary naming work, not clearance or buyer validation.
findings.selected_action: Name research remains preliminary; no trademark clearance or buyer validation claim.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The sandbox contains a broad React/WebGL animation stack that is not required by the current V4 visual authority and has no browser rendering proof.
findings.selected_action: Archived only authored library setup/lockfiles; optional tool inventory creates no dependency requirement. Live WebGL remains off by default.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Three palettes and a rich motion standard are useful comparison evidence but can become parallel implementation work if their statuses are not explicit.
findings.selected_action: Selected wonder_method_ink as active; other palettes remain comparison studies, with bounded prerendered hero media.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The older playbook's nine-stage pipeline and separate research/account examples make a non-authorized research example look like active qualified pipeline.
findings.selected_action: Historical account research is labeled research; leads and active jobs share one board and six current phases.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Outbound drafts did not make authorization and stopping behavior operationally clear.
findings.selected_action: Drafts remain unsent; respect declines and allow one contextual follow-up. Plan creation grants no sending permission.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Fit, scope, authority, budget and CMS compatibility can be discussed without a clear 20-minute decision rule.
findings.selected_action: Restored a twenty-minute fit conversation with an explicit next decision and a no-change/no-fit option.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The buyer can see package prices without a single compact explanation of exact routes, limits, milestones, external bills and change rules.
findings.selected_action: One scope sheet records routes, limits, milestones, mandatory/optional costs, changes and ownership.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Static delivery, account ownership and unsupported application work can surface after a deposit.
findings.selected_action: Editing, account ownership and application exclusions are settled before deposit.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Recurring services and first-year arithmetic can be read as an unlimited subscription or as a guaranteed result.
findings.selected_action: Bound recurring units and illustrate optional cost separately from outcomes; no results guarantee.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Approval and communication can be inferred from compliments, silence or fragmented feedback, creating scope and schedule disputes.
findings.selected_action: Written version acceptance and one consolidated list; silence does not bill a milestone.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: A lead log can drift into unnecessary personal-data collection and speculative prospect research.
findings.selected_action: Keep necessary appropriate business contact only; record source/confidence and avoid speculative personal enrichment.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The four existing ZIPs are valid byte-consistent snapshots, but only V3/V4 have per-file package manifests and those manifests intentionally omit themselves.
findings.selected_action: Preserved 270 authored prior-plan files byte-for-byte and hashed every historical member plus archive; current package manifest excludes itself explicitly.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Every old frontdoor resolves its local hrefs and has matching chapter counts, but carrying four active frontdoors into V5 would create competing navigation and authority.
findings.selected_action: One V5 front door; prior full reports are reachable only through clearly historical ZIPs.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 drops the two V3 raw legacy keyword source files even though its keyword manifest still claims and embeds the 482-term inventory (359 legacy plus 123 hypotheses).
findings.selected_action: Restored the exact V3 raw keyword pair, with hashes checked.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Research JSON contains provenance paths into work/ and sibling outputs/ folders that cannot be followed from a standalone V5 archive.
findings.selected_action: Mapped legacy output paths to archive members and bundled work references where possible; named unbundled authoring references without inventing files.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 evidence retains many historical $349 Care, rejected setup/Growth and other V3 terms; its current docs do mark them as superseded, but a flat V5 reference list could promote stale candidates.
findings.selected_action: Separated research/historical candidates from current commercial authority; selected-unit finances remain current.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The V4 authoring workspace has generators, validators and BRIEF.md omitted from the user-facing output; copying them into the current core would add build machinery without a user dependency.
findings.selected_action: The HTML report is prebuilt and standalone; no private authoring generator is required to read it.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The design-library folder is a local installation snapshot, not a website dependency bundle; node_modules is large, platform-specific and unnecessary for a standalone plan.
findings.selected_action: Preserved INSTALLATION.md/package.json/package-lock.json only; excluded installed node_modules.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: V4 has several overlapping authorities. OFFERS names offers.json as the machine-readable authority; SERVICE_PLAYBOOK also points to offers.json; CODEX_HANDOFF distributes authority across offers.json, OFFERS.md, purchase-contract.json, site-map.json, keyword-manifest.json, SEARCH_AND_CONTENT.md, content-plan.json, BRAND_AND_MOBILE.md, design-tokens.json, workflows.json, founder-calendar.json, OPERATING_SYSTEM.md, economics.json, buyer-costs.json and build-contract.json. A reader cannot tell which page is the current decision source versus deep evidence.
findings.selected_action: One starting page points to offers, operations, build brief and reference; one authority map resolves domain ownership.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Buyer-facing OFFERS exposes internal planning budgets: 55/85 founder hours in the website cards and a 1.5h/2.5h/0.5h/0.75h/0.75h/1h Search budget. Those numbers invite an hourly entitlement reading even though BUSINESS_PLAN says the price is for a fixed deliverable and internal hours are only a planning boundary.
findings.selected_action: Removed internal labor-hour budgets from buyer cards; kept fixed deliverables and finance assumptions in reference.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Caveats are repeated at the point of sale and again in internal handoff pages: not cheapest/best/fastest, no guarantees, unknown cash and availability, no live-site proof, no browser preview, no GBP, no 24/7 restoration, no forced Sprint, and no ranking/traffic/revenue guarantee. The repetition makes ordinary scope harder to find and makes the business sound defensive.
findings.selected_action: Condensed repeated caveats while retaining material scope, price, ownership and response boundaries.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The public menu creates too many choices at once: two builds, Care, Sprint, direct Monthly Search, Care plus Search, three add-on units, ten 12/24-month rows, and historical V3 comparisons. The buyer must understand baseline state, service eligibility, bundles and renewal logic before choosing a website.
findings.selected_action: Two build choices and optional services form the buyer path; detailed variants live behind the calculator/reference.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: OPERATING_SYSTEM repeats capacity and readiness in several forms: 35/40/50-hour scenarios, weekly and monthly ceilings, steady-state sensitivities, 85h/145h gate language, 95.2/123.2/140 post-gate capacity and a second detailed readiness section. BUSINESS_PLAN and START_HERE repeat parts of the same gate. These are useful internal estimates but poor front-door reading and can look like promises or arbitrary waiting rules.
findings.selected_action: Removed practice-hour/post-week-six capacity rules; actual dated booking evidence controls.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: The record system is larger than the operating flow requires. SERVICE_PLAYBOOK has nine templates, while OPERATING_SYSTEM repeats Fit through Exit controls and a weekly review, and CODEX_HANDOFF repeats build, QA, acceptance and handoff steps. Scope, approvals, QA, ownership and cancellation appear in multiple records with slightly different prompts.
findings.selected_action: Reusable event sections append to the same records; no separate checklist/dashboard product is required.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Historical V3 comparisons and rejected candidates appear beside current offers: 15 versus 30 minutes, $600 setup, $1,800 Growth, $249 quarterly check, $399 alternative and V3 cost deltas. A buyer who only needs the current price now has to learn which numbers are dead.
findings.selected_action: Historical offers remain labeled research/history and are removed from the current public menu.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Fixed 85-hour rehearsal and illustrative week-7 deposit gate can delay sales by construction without proving paid delivery.
findings.selected_action: Removed arbitrary elapsed-practice gate without weakening sold-scope launch tests.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Care alerts and next-business-day acknowledgment depend on unconfirmed solo coverage and fragile 1.25-hour economics.
findings.selected_action: Actual staffed coverage and a full-quarter cost check gate Care enrollment/scale; the financial risk remains explicit.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Client-controlled repository/accounts, final-payment source transfer and five-business-day cancellation handoff have an unresolved mid-project edge case.
findings.selected_action: Paid bespoke/source deliverables stay usable at paid milestones or reconciled termination; client accounts remain accessible throughout.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Illustrative 35/40/50-hour scenario and pooled reserve can be mistaken for actual sellable capacity or used to overlap review/launch peaks.
findings.selected_action: Actual weekly review/QA/launch/correction calendar controls parallel work; scenarios are not inventory.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Static ownership may be mistaken for self-service editing despite no CMS and only 15 Care edit minutes.
findings.selected_action: Static technical editing and separately scoped CMS are clear before deposit; Care has a fifteen-minute supplied-edit allowance.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: 69-file V4 package repeats current and rejected decisions; V3 raw legacy keyword evidence is not carried in V4.
findings.selected_action: One current entry, grouped reference, full history and restored raw evidence eliminate the omitted-file/competing-authority gap.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Premium price and design/QA superiority lack paid client cases or willingness-to-pay proof while comparable lower-price competitors exist and pre-acquisition build contribution is thin.
findings.selected_action: Kept prices as paid-test hypotheses and exposed thin acquisition-adjusted contribution. Demand, time savings and superiority remain unproven.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.

findings.issue: Seven prompt-library units plus prompt/version/output/time records and daily review queues risk creating a second operating product.
findings.selected_action: One production prompt, three records, existing vault/invoices; no startup portal or seven-prompt-library dependency.
findings.execution_status: Plan change only; production and commercial evidence still required where applicable.
